changes_vs_v1: fix 1: focus-lottery students (Sunnyside, Bridger, Buckman) are a separate population. A school with its own change follows PPS's stated rule: Buckman's enrolled students split 50/50 Abernethy/Sunnyside (Oct 6 memo p. 2); Sunnyside K-5 lottery students stay through grade 5 then return home (Sunnyside guide p. 3); Bridger 6-8 lottery students go to Harrison Park (Bridger guide p. 3); Sunnyside 6-8 lottery students return home. Returners live where Census residents live in the host's high-school cluster.

fix 2: ~117 Lent-area non-DLI students (Marysville today; PPS capture report Oct 2025) are modeled. PPS baselines A/B keep them with Marysville at Arleta (PPS phase-in, Marysville guide p. 3); options assign them by where they live.

fix 3: DLI arrival shares for moved strands implied by PPS Family Guide projections (not PPS-stated): Lent ~0.80, Rigler ~0.83, Woodstock 0.84-0.93, Chavez ~0.89, Beaumont->Roseway ~0.90; non-arrivals stay at the sending school if it still serves those grades, else go home.
fix 4: capacities from PPS 2025-26 school profiles (captured second-hand via pps-dli-explorer snapshots; archived in build/pps-texts/school-profiles-2025-26/).
fix 5: targets.md: 70-100% utilization is a PPS-stated aim (Family Guide glossary p. 2; PPS staff, Sept 15 2026 board meeting).
fix 6: durability uses each school's own PSU July 2026 Table 5.5 forecast by year to 2035-36.
PPS A 9-12 lines kept in every option.

horizon "pps2031": durability requires meet-or-beat PPS A's count at target every year 2027-28 to 2031-32 at every level (PPS Family Guide p. 1, "Estimates cover 2027-28 through 2031-32"; per-school PSU Table 5.5 sizes); 2032-33 to 2035-36 reported only; the 2036-41 district-trend extension is dropped.
middle->high feeders are a soft cost: 200 kid-miles per extra high school a middle zone feeds, no floor; K-5 not hard-nested in A's high-school lines (0.1 kid-mile per kid across a line).
